---
title: "LIQPLAT baseline population table"
format: html
---

- ITT population by assignment, regardless of invitation acceptance.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(arrow)
library(here)
library(table1)
library(tidyverse)

source(here("R", "covariates.R"))

private_dir <- here("data", "private")
results_dir <- here("analysis", "01-population", "results")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: read

cohort <- read_parquet(here(private_dir, "cohort_follow_up.parquet")) |>
  as.data.frame()

qol <- read_parquet(here(private_dir, "qol.parquet")) |>
  as.data.frame()

# The first-contact date is exported as date_visit (legacy name visit_date).
visit_field <- intersect(c("date_visit", "visit_date"), names(cohort))

stopifnot(
  length(visit_field) == 1L,
  c(
    "id", "tx", "gender", "age", "ecog_fstcnt", "baseline_q29",
    "baseline_q30", "diagnosis", "albumin", "c_reactive_protein", "stage_binary"
  ) %in% names(cohort),
  c("id", "assessment_id", "questionnaire_date", "q29", "q30") %in% names(qol),
  !anyDuplicated(cohort$id),
  cohort$tx %in% 0:1,
  is.na(cohort$gender) | cohort$gender %in% c("female", "male"),
  is.na(cohort$ecog_fstcnt) | cohort$ecog_fstcnt %in% 0:4,
  is.na(cohort$stage_binary) | cohort$stage_binary %in% 0:1
)
```

## Baseline QoL items

```{r}
#| label: baseline-items

visits <- tibble(
  id = cohort$id,
  date_visit = as.Date(cohort[[visit_field]])
)

closest_items <- qol |>
  select(id, assessment_id, questionnaire_date, q29, q30) |>
  pivot_longer(
    c(q29, q30),
    names_to = "item",
    names_transform = \(item) factor(item, levels = c("q29", "q30")),
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(value), !is.na(questionnaire_date)) |>
  inner_join(visits, by = "id") |>
  mutate(
    distance_days = abs(as.integer(as.Date(questionnaire_date) - date_visit))
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(distance_days), distance_days <= 14L) |>
  arrange(id, item, distance_days, questionnaire_date, assessment_id) |>
  distinct(id, item, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  select(id, item, value) |>
  # names_expand keeps both closest_ columns even if one item has no candidate.
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = item,
    values_from = value,
    names_prefix = "closest_",
    names_expand = TRUE
  )

cohort <- cohort |>
  left_join(closest_items, by = "id") |>
  mutate(
    baseline_q29 = coalesce(baseline_q29, closest_q29),
    baseline_q30 = coalesce(baseline_q30, closest_q30)
  ) |>
  select(-closest_q29, -closest_q30)
```

## QL2 score

- Scored per the [EORTC QLQ-C30 manual](https://qol.eortc.org/app/uploads/sites/2/2018/02/SCmanual.pdf).

```{r}
#| label: ql2

stopifnot(
  "Baseline QoL items must be integers from 1 to 7 or missing." =
    (is.na(cohort$baseline_q29) | cohort$baseline_q29 %in% 1:7) &
      (is.na(cohort$baseline_q30) | cohort$baseline_q30 %in% 1:7)
)

cohort <- cohort |>
  mutate(
    # Items run 1 (best) to 7 (worst), so reverse them (8 - item) first.
    ql2 = (rowMeans(cbind(8 - baseline_q29, 8 - baseline_q30), na.rm = TRUE) - 1) /
      6 * 100,
    # rowMeans() of two missing items is NaN.
    ql2 = if_else(is.nan(ql2), NA_real_, ql2)
  )

stopifnot(
  "QL2 must lie within [0, 100]." =
    is.na(cohort$ql2) | between(cohort$ql2, 0, 100)
)
```

## Table variables

```{r}
#| label: table-variables

cohort <- cohort |>
  mutate(
    group = factor(
      tx,
      levels = c(1, 0),
      labels = c("ctDNA", "Usual care")
    ),
    gender = factor(gender, levels = c("female", "male"), labels = c("Female", "Male")),
    ecog_fstcnt = factor(ecog_fstcnt, levels = 0:4),
    diagnosis = snomed_to_diagnosis(as.character(diagnosis)),
    mgps = factor(derive_mgps(albumin, c_reactive_protein), levels = 0:2),
    stage_binary = factor(
      stage_binary,
      levels = 0:1,
      labels = c("Locally advanced", "Metastasised")
    )
  )

if (any(str_detect(cohort$diagnosis, "^SNM_"))) {
  stop("Add labels for unmapped diagnosis codes.")
}

cohort <- cohort |>
  mutate(diagnosis = factor(diagnosis))

label(cohort$gender) <- "Gender"
label(cohort$age) <- "Age (years)"
label(cohort$ecog_fstcnt) <- "ECOG at first contact"
label(cohort$ql2) <- "Global health status / QoL (QL2, 0–100)"
label(cohort$diagnosis) <- "Diagnosis"
label(cohort$mgps) <- "Modified Glasgow Prognostic Score (mGPS)"
label(cohort$stage_binary) <- "Disease stage"
```

## Table 1

```{r}
#| label: baseline-table

footnote <- paste(
  "PROMs are considered up to 14 days after first contact.",
  "QL2: higher scores indicate better QoL.",
  "Per EORTC scoring, one available item is sufficient; both missing gives a missing score.",
  "mGPS uses baseline CRP and albumin; missing either gives a missing score.",
  "Percentages include missing observations in the denominator."
)

baseline_table <- table1(
  ~ gender + age + ecog_fstcnt + ql2 + diagnosis + mgps + stage_binary | group,
  data = cohort,
  overall = "Overall",
  render.continuous = c(. = "Median [Q1, Q3]"),
  render.categorical = "FREQ (PCT%)",
  topclass = "Rtable1-zebra",
  footnote = footnote
)

saveRDS(baseline_table, here(results_dir, "baseline-table1.rds"))

# Aggregate display cells only, never participant-level records.
write_parquet(
  as.data.frame(baseline_table),
  here(results_dir, "baseline-characteristics.parquet")
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-baseline-table1
#| echo: false
#| tbl-cap: "Baseline characteristics by randomized invitation assignment."

baseline_table
```

```{r}
#| label: ql2-item-availability
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

n_both_items <- sum(!is.na(cohort$baseline_q29) & !is.na(cohort$baseline_q30))
n_one_item <- sum(xor(is.na(cohort$baseline_q29), is.na(cohort$baseline_q30)))
n_no_item <- sum(is.na(cohort$baseline_q29) & is.na(cohort$baseline_q30))

str_glue(
  "QL2 uses both baseline items for {n_both_items} participants and one item ",
  "for {n_one_item}; {n_no_item} have neither item.\n"
) |>
  cat()
```
